question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The act of killing one’s mother
solution: The correct answer is "**Matricide"**. ***__Key Points__** __ • Let us understand the meaning of the correct word: • **Matricide__:** the** killing of one's mother**; a person who kills their mother. __ • Example: He was arrested for ****matricide**.* • Example: *This man is suspected of **matricide***. • Clearly, the word **'m****atricide**' can be best substituted with the given group of words '**t****he act of killing one’s mother**'. • Hence, the correct answer is: ***Matricide*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • Let us understand the meaning of the remaining options: **Word**__ __**Meaning**__ __**Example**__ **Regicide** a person who kills or takes part in **killing a king.** *This man is suspected of **r****egicide**.* **Homicide** the **killing of one person by another.** *He was charged with **homicide**.* **Uxoricide** the **killing of one's wife.** *I got a case related to **uxoricide**.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • Regicide: राजा-हत्या • Example: 17वीं शताब्दी में अंग्रेज़ राजा चार्ल्स प्रथम की राजा-हत्या हुई। • In the 17th century, King Charles I of England was a victim of regicide.) • Homicide: मानव-हत्या • Example: पुलिस ने उसे मानव-हत्या के आरोप में गिरफ्तार किया। • The police arrested him on charges of homicide.) • Uxoricide: पत्नी-हत्या • Example: उसका पति उसकी पत्नी-हत्या के आरोप में सजा भुगत रहा है। • Her husband is serving a sentence for committing uxoricide.) • Matricide: मातृ-हत्या • Example: उसने भयंकर गुस्से में अपनी मां की मातृ-हत्या कर दी। • In a fit of fierce anger, he committed matricide.) 18c:Tf3b, The correct answer is "**You will not play this game**".
